name: Coffee With Bro - Project Command Reference
description: Ready-to-use commands to test all codes (ESLint, build) and run frontend and backend concurrently.

test:all.description: Run ESLint and TypeScript production build in frontend to test all code
test:all.command: npm --prefix milk_with_bro run lint && npm --prefix milk_with_bro run build

test:frontend:build.description: Run TypeScript check and Vite production build

start:both.description: Start both frontend and backend server concurrently
start:both.powershell: Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-Command', 'cd milk_with_bro; npm run dev'; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-Command', 'cd coffee_with_bro; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run'

vscodeTasks.testTask: Open Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) -> 'Tasks: Run Task' -> 'Test All (Lint & Build)'
vscodeTasks.startBothTask: Open Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) -> 'Tasks: Run Task' -> 'Start Frontend & Server'
